scope: Private same-ELF nominal-step legacy/shared VU0 packet comparison. Both arms use the same pooled EE path, common compiled pose functions and world-first chained schedule. Shared records are immutable through the micro fence; all possible contacts are canonical EE. Different packet counts and EE-confirmation classes are expected. Admission requires ordered workload/contact fingerprints, kernel startup/replay gates and zero missed canonical hits. Timing requires this same ELF without shadow/window probes. This does not qualify production-clock FPS.
